'''Homefront VI''' is the 24th virtual expansion for [[Star Trek CCG 1st Edition]]. It is published by [[The Continuing Committee]] on May 29, 2015. The set consists of 48 cards. This set is part of the ''Core Block'' consisting of cards from [[Homefront]], [[Homefront II]], [[Homefront III]], [[Homefront IV]], [[Homefront V]], and [[Homefront VI]].

==Type Breakdown==
*1 [[:Category:Artifact (Star Trek CCG 1E)|Artifact]]
*18 [[:Category:Dilemma (Star Trek CCG 1E)|Dilemma]]
*3 [[:Category:Doorway (Star Trek CCG 1E)|Doorway]]
*7 [[:Category:Event (Star Trek CCG 1E)|Event]]
*13 [[:Category:Facility (Star Trek CCG 1E)|Facility]] (1 Bajoran, 1 Borg, 1 Cardassian, 1 Dominion, 2 Federation, 1 Ferengi, 1 Hirogen, 1 Kazon, 2 Klingon, 1 Romulan and 1 Vidiian)
*4 [[:Category:Incident (Star Trek CCG 1E)|Incident]]
